Disney's Moana (2026) is flopping hard in theaters right now. In this video, I talk about why movies like The Lion King (2019) and Lilo & Stich (2025) hit so big, while Moana, despite Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson, and Snow White (2025) did not. I think it tells us something real about where Disney remakes are going.
